summary.en: A major archaeological museum presenting the ancient Shu civilisation and its remarkable bronze artefacts. Official ticketing and visitor rules were checked on the museum website.

visitDuration.display: Allow 3–5 hours, plus travel from Chengdu.

visitorTips: Book through the museum’s official website, official WeChat account or official Douyin account; the museum states it has not authorised third-party ticket sellers.
Individual tickets are released daily at 20:00 Beijing time, up to five days ahead. Holiday ticket releases may be announced separately.

The official site has an inbound-tourist booking channel. Foreign visitors should use that route and bring the original passport; the official guide says successful reservations must be exchanged at the ticket centre.

Regular exhibition-hall hours: 08:30–18:00; ticket checking stops at 17:00. Restoration Hall: 09:00–18:00. Selected holidays and school-break periods may extend exhibition-hall hours to 20:00, with extended-ticket entry from 17:00 and stopping at 18:00.

Official ticket price: adult CNY 72; listed concessions include CNY 65 for eligible veterans and CNY 36 for full-time students through undergraduate level. Eligibility and document requirements should be checked on the booking page.
The museum is in Guanghan, Sichuan, outside central Chengdu. Allow separate travel time.

openingHours.text: Exhibition Hall: 08:30–18:00; ticket check stops 17:00. Restoration Hall: 09:00–18:00. Selected holidays and school-break periods may extend Exhibition Hall hours to 08:30–20:00; extended-ticket entry begins 17:00 and stops 18:00. Closed on Chinese New Year’s Eve, subject to temporary notices.
